$description: A5 component registry (step 1 of the PA.1 plan, DS-05): every UI component, its atomic level, where it lives now and where step 2/3 moves it. Docs only for now; the step-5 guard-rail lint will read it. Update it whenever a component is added, moved, merged or renamed. Exceptions: EXCEPTIONS.md. Findings behind each entry: ATOMIC-AUDIT.md.

fields.name: A5 name, unique across levels (A5 §3: no level prefix needed).
fields.level: atom | molecule | organism | template | page | outside. 'outside' = renderer, reference page or app shell: not part of the levels (EXCEPTIONS.md E3, E4).
fields.now: Where it lives today. {file, symbol} is a component; {file, class} is a part that exists only as CSS classes; {file, symbol, class} is a class-only part rendered inside that component. Several entries = built more than once, to be merged.
fields.target: Folder after the move (A5 §4). Pages go to frontend/src/pages/.
fields.status: component (one exported component) | internal (inside a bigger file, not exported) | class-only (CSS, no component yet) | duplicated (built more than once) | planned (being built by another session) | missing (not needed yet).
fields.uses: Components it renders today (A5 names). Raw HTML it styles itself is under 'built'.
fields.built: atoms | molecules = built only from lower levels (plus the E1 atoms); raw = styles raw HTML itself; mixed = some of each. For atoms: always 'raw' (that is what atoms are).
fields.step: Plan step that moves or creates it (ATOMIC-AUDIT.md → Proposed plan). 'PI' = the icon session (A3.1).
fields.notes: What changes, and anything to watch.

components.name: Icon
components.notes: The icon session (A3.1 PI.1–PI.3) builds the new Icon atom in the target folder (Icon.tsx, registry.ts, custom/, test, README). ui/icons.tsx stays as a deprecated wrapper (Icon.X → <Icon name=… />) until no file uses it. Other sessions don't edit these files.

components.name: ToolIcon
components.notes: The 21 drawing-tool glyphs; replaced by Icon names in the icon session's swap (PI.3).

components.name: Button
components.notes: Variants primary / secondary / ghost / danger, sizes sm / md / lg, pill. Owns hover, pressed (the shared pressed layer in design/ui.css) and disabled. The class-only text button .pc-link (ToolCall's Undo) becomes a 'link' variant in step 3. E1: may be used directly in organisms.

components.name: IconButton
components.notes: 32 × 32, ghost; 'pressed' and 'marks' variants. Feature CSS restyles it in two places (.ed-zoom, .ed-right-tabs): those become variants in step 3. E1: may be used directly in organisms.

components.name: RoundButton
components.notes: 40 px round arrow button; stays its own export beside Button.

components.name: Input
components.notes: TextInput moves in step 2 (export name kept). The editor's inline inputs (Properties values, file name, prompt line) become an 'inline' variant in step 3.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Select moves in step 2; the editor's inline selects become an 'inline' variant in step 3.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Track plus its label text.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Chip keeps its export name (accent variant). The file-status pill (Draft · In review · Approved) becomes a Badge tone in step 3. E1: Chip may be used directly in organisms.

components.name: StatusDot
components.notes: Dot plus word, tones ok / warn / error / accent. IssueRow sets its dot colour inline today; it becomes a StatusDot tone in step 3.

components.name: Kbd
components.notes: Three looks for one idea. .vlt-kbd is used in the Vault sidebar search, both ⌘K palettes and the Vault Help; the editor palette borrows it from vault.css.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: Pastel, the same in both themes on purpose (component tokens avatar.*). Round for people, square for the workspace. The VaultPage copy is the component page's demo.

components.name: Thumbnail
components.notes: White paper look (component tokens paper.*). Thumb loads the drawing itself with useVault(); the atom gets it as a prop and the page or organism container loads it (A5 §5.5).

components.name: Divider
components.notes: Vertical in toolbars, horizontal in menus. ToolbarSep keeps its export name.

components.name: Text

now.class: pc-display pc-title pc-section pc-small pc-micro pc-mono pc-eyebrow pc-label pc-muted pc-quiet

components.notes: The type styles are classes used everywhere; the classes stay valid. Step 4 points them at the semantic type.* tokens (unused today). A Text component only if it earns its place.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.notes: User and assistant bubbles. Not used in the app yet (chat comes with P4).

components.name: ScaleBar
components.notes: Its length comes from the drawing on screen (scaleBarLength).

components.name: ResizeHandle
components.notes: Panel edge (separator role, keyboard resizing). Imports clampWidth from editor/panels.ts; the limits come in as props when it moves. Build-owned file.

components.name: Spinner
components.notes: Only when needed (with the server).

components.name: Skeleton
components.notes: Vault audit V14: loading skeletons, with the server.

components.name: FormField
components.notes: Label + control (passed in) + help or error text. Field keeps its export name.

components.name: DimensionInput
components.notes: Input + unit (m, ft, m²). NumberInput keeps its export name; built from the Input atom in step 3.

components.name: Segmented
components.notes: Radio group, one Tab stop, arrow keys. Restyled from outside by .ed-status (step 3: a size variant).

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: Tab list with counts; restyled from outside by .ed-right-tabs (step 3: a variant).

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: Label + shortcut; uses the Kbd atom once it exists (step 3).

components.name: MetricStat
components.notes: Label, mono value, unit, optional bar. MetricTile keeps its export name.

components.name: IssueRow
components.notes: Severity dot (inline colour → StatusDot tone, step 3), message + fix as one button (P3.2), object chips, optional action.

components.name: ToolCallCard
components.notes: Eyebrow, step list, Undo link (→ Button 'link' variant). ToolCall keeps its export name. Chat comes with P4.

components.name: SelectionPill
components.notes: Recolours its Button with an inline style today; that becomes a Button tone in step 3.

components.name: PanelSection
components.notes: Collapsible section: header button with chevron, title, count; 'flush' variant (P3.2).

components.name: Card
components.notes: Title, ↗ when it opens a detail, corner marks.

components.name: MenuItem
components.notes: Icon, label, shortcut (→ Kbd), ✓ for the chosen option, danger and disabled states.

components.name: NavItem
components.notes: Icon, label, count (.vlt-count → Badge), active state. Hover, pressed and a dark-theme override live in vault.css today; they move into the molecule (pressed reuses the shared rule).

components.name: TreeItem
components.notes: Vault folder rows, folder picker rows and the editor's room rows: one molecule with hover, selected (with a bar, not colour alone), drag-over and disabled.

components.name: SearchField
components.notes: Input look + Kbd (⌘K). In the Vault it is a button that opens the palette.

components.name: ToolButton
components.notes: IconButton + tool icon + key in the tooltip, inside the floating toolbar.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.notes: Link + chevron; drag-over state lives in dashboard.css.

components.name: EmptyState
components.notes: Eyebrow title, one sentence, actions (passed in).

components.name: PropertyRow
components.notes: Label + value, editable (inline Input or Select) or read-only, with its provenance chip.

components.name: FileCard
components.notes: Paper thumbnail, name, meta, status; selected outline.

components.name: FolderArt
components.notes: E2: illustration values stay exact. Contains the AvatarGroup and content chips.

components.name: FolderTile
components.notes: Button around the art (passed in as children) with name and meta; hover, drag-over, selected.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.notes: Overlapping avatars on the glass folder; built from the Avatar atom.

components.name: VersionChip
components.notes: Branch / version button in the editor top bar (Phase 15 grows it).

components.name: ColourSwatches
components.notes: Folder colour choice (radio group).

components.name: GraphLegend
components.notes: New in P3.3 (Build): names each kind of link with a line sample.

components.name: Dialog
components.notes: The frame of every dialog: title, body, footer, backdrop. Focus handling is in ui/modal.ts (useModalFocus).

components.name: FormDialog
components.notes: Dialog with a form, Cancel and a submit button.

components.name: Toolbar
components.notes: Frame with one Tab stop and arrow keys; holds ToolButtons and Dividers.

components.name: Menu
components.notes: + New and right-click menus; MenuItem and Divider come out in step 3.

components.name: SettingsDialog
components.notes: Text size (DS-03).

components.name: CommandPalette
components.notes: Three copies (Vault, editor, component-page demo). The editor copy imports useModalFocus via vault/dialogs.tsx and is styled by vault.css. One shared organism; each page passes its commands (TASKS.md follow-up from P2.2a).

components.name: HelpDialog
components.notes: One frame (shortcut list with Kbd); the Vault and the editor pass their own shortcuts.

components.name: VaultSidebar
components.notes: Workspace, search, nav, projects tree, footer nav. Built from NavItem, SearchField and Avatar once they exist. The VaultPage copy is the component-page demo.

components.name: ProjectsTree
components.notes: Folder tree; audit B1 (one Tab stop, arrow keys) belongs here.

components.name: FileCards
components.notes: Grid of FileCard molecules.

components.name: FilesTable
components.notes: Sortable headers, row hover and focus live in dashboard.css / vault.css today. The VaultPage copy is the component-page demo.

components.name: ItemsView
components.notes: Sort, grid/list switch and the item views, shared by Starred, Trash and Search.

components.name: NameDialog
components.notes: New folder / rename; colour swatches → ColourSwatches.

components.name: FolderPickerDialog
components.notes: Rows → TreeItem.

components.name: ImportResultDialog
components.notes: Uses the StatusDot atom directly (not an E1 atom): wrap or list in step 3.

components.name: SearchFilters
components.notes: The filter row of the Search page; the page keeps the data.

components.name: LibraryTable
components.notes: Plan Library list; could share FilesTable.

components.name: EditorTopBar
components.notes: Home, file name (inline Input), VersionChip, save status, avatar, panel toggles, Share. Feature CSS restyles Chip and Status here (.ed-top .pc-chip / .pc-status).

components.name: EditorRail
components.notes: Left icon rail (panels, Help, Settings).

components.name: ToolRail
components.notes: The floating drawing toolbar with undo / redo.

components.name: SidePanel
components.notes: Panel head with close, body; sliding and edge tabs (.ed-side, .ed-edge) in editor.css.

components.name: RoomList
components.notes: Rows → TreeItem.

components.name: PropertiesPanel
components.notes: Build-owned file; GraphFacts is new in P3.3.

components.name: IssuesPanel
components.notes: P3.2 (Build). Uses StatusDot and Switch directly (not E1 atoms): a summary-line and a labelled-switch molecule, or an E1 entry, in step 3.

components.name: MetricsPanel
components.notes: Feature CSS restyles the tile (.ed-metrics .pc-tile): a variant in step 3.

components.name: EditorStatusBar
components.notes: Units, snap, zoom; the snap and zoom-value buttons are raw (.ed-snap, .ed-zoom-value).

components.name: ToolPrompt
components.notes: Prompt line: next expected input, options (inline Select), typed value (inline Input).

components.name: ChatPanel
components.notes: Placeholder column until P4; will use ChatBubble and ToolCallCard.

components.name: EditorShell
components.notes: Shell (about 1,000 lines) holds the template and most editor organisms; split one organism per commit (DS-05 answer 5), with Build.

components.name: VaultLayout
components.notes: Sidebar + header + content regions.

components.name: EditorPage
components.notes: Loads a Vault file or library plan; autosave, checks and commands stay here (A5 §5.5).

components.name: VaultApp
components.notes: Routes between the Vault pages, owns data and dialogs. Imports LAST_FILE_KEY from editor/useFileSave.ts (sideways): move the key to a shared module in step 3.

components.name: FolderPage
components.notes: Home and every folder.

components.name: SearchPage
components.notes: Filters in the address (#/search?…).

components.name: LibraryPage
components.notes: Plan Library (read-only DocumentStore).

components.name: App
components.notes: App shell: routes by the address; stays where it is.

components.name: Canvas
components.notes: E3 renderer: gestures, pan / zoom, snapping. canvas.* tokens stay semantic (A5 §3).

components.name: PlanView
components.notes: E3 renderer: SVG of the drawing.

components.name: GraphOverlay
components.notes: E3 renderer: Plan Graph over the drawing (P3.3).

components.name: ToolShapes
components.notes: E3 renderer: live previews of the drawing tools.

components.name: StyleGuide
components.notes: E4 reference page (/styleguide.html); gets the levels view in step 6 (PA.5).

components.name: VaultComponentPage
components.notes: E4 reference page (/vault.html, P14.1). Its demo copies (Avatar, Sidebar, FilesTable, Palette) are replaced by the real organisms in step 6. Imports styleguide.css.
